issues.description: Method 'config_system': the problem statement (problem_statement.md lines 21-23) explicitly requires implementing config_system to accept a pointer to a Config-Struct, but the solution implementation (solution_repository/helloWorld.asm line 6) treats the incoming stack argument as an integer value (comment and code read [esp+4] and use it as an integer). This is a concrete parameter-type/signature mismatch that will confuse students about the expected calling convention and data layout for config_system and may lead to incorrect implementations or runtime errors.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the expectation consistent across artifacts. Either: (A) change the solution implementation to accept a pointer: load the pointer from [esp+4], then dereference that pointer to access Config-Struct fields (and document this calling convention), and add a matching config_system stub to the template; or (B) update the problem statement to state that config_system receives an integer (explain semantics), and update the template and solution comments to match. Ensure the template repository contains a same-signature stub so students know where and how to implement the function.
